name.value: Executive Suites Hotel & Conference Centre Burnaby

description.value: A four-time TripAdvisor Traveler's Choice Award winner, the Executive Suites is a full-service, all-suite hotel in the Burnaby/Brentwood area with 125 spacious suites, each equipped with a fridge, microwave, and sink. The on-site Acqua Restaurant & Bar, outdoor heated pool, hot tub, and fitness centre provide solid infrastructure for a multi-night stay. The hotel sits minutes from a SkyTrain station, giving car-free or bike-and-transit cyclists quick access to downtown Vancouver.

raw_osm.name: Executive Suites Hotel & Conference Centre Burnaby

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and confirms an active, open hotel at 4201 Lougheed Hwy, Burnaby. Phone numbers and address match OSM exactly. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, or cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site; Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed as complimentary in multiple room descriptions, and room desks with 'multiple outlets' support device charging; the on-site Acqua Restaurant & Bar confirms nearby evening food.
concerns: OSM email 'info@exectivehotelburnaby.ca' contains a typo ('exective' instead of 'executive'); website contact page uses @executivehotels.net domain addresses, suggesting the OSM email may be outdated or incorrect.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable hotel with a fully functional website and confirmed contact details. A legitimate overnight option for touring cyclists in the Burnaby area.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site Acqua Restaurant & Bar serves meals and cocktails; room service also available

Device charging.detail: Room descriptions note 'custom work desk with multiple outlet' and 'work station with multiple outlet' in suite types

wow_evidence: outdoor heated pool, hot tub, and fitness centre
